text: Lesson fourteen confirmed this is a binding mistake, not a formula mistake, so the fix matches that diagnosis exactly: a rebinding, not a rewrite.

Click the headline card, remove Total Sales All Territories from the Values well, and drag in the plain Total Sales measure instead. Nothing about the benchmark measure's DAX changes. It's still correct and still needed.

Validate against at least four territories, confirming the card now matches the table every time, and that clearing the slicer still shows the full company total. Then recheck the Segment page too, since it carries the same measure-naming risk.

As a defensive change, rename both all-territories and all-segments benchmark measures for clarity. Power BI updates every reference automatically, so Pct of Company Total keeps working. A Benchmarks display folder keeps them visually separated going forward.
With the fix validated and the model cleaned up, next lesson wraps up everything this project built and bridges to the Advanced project ahead.
